newsitem.title: GREECE: HELLENIC CULTURE FOUNDATION OPENS PARTHENON EXHIBIT IN JAPAN.
newsitem.headline: HELLENIC CULTURE FOUNDATION OPENS PARTHENON EXHIBIT IN JAPAN.

text.p: A major exhibition on the architecture and conservation of the Parthenon opens in Osaka, Japan at the city museum September 25, the Hellenic Culture Foundation said.

"In Japan the Foundation of Hellenic Culture is promoting the most important achievement of Greece in the sphere of conservation of historic monuments: the restoration of the Parthenon," it said in a statement.
The exhibit features a complete, full scale copy of the west frieze, 21 metres in length. It was designed by architect George Panetsos.
Drawings, photographs, models and reconstructions illustrate the work carried out on the restoration of the Parthenon by the committee for the conservation of the Acropolis monuments.

The exhibition is a prelude to an international symposium on preserving the cultural heritage in Osaka and Athens to be held October 6-8 in the science information centre of Osaka University. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
